subtask: L4 analyze (XA V2CoAl site/total moments + ferrimagnetic order)
kind: ABACUS Mulliken analyze (heavy leaf; the agent reads our reproduced output, runs nothing)
provenance: values from 3_reproduction/L4/result.json (our converged ABACUS run; the self-consistent ground truth). The total is the per-f.u. sum of the per-atom Mulliken moments in mulliken.txt (cell 7.99944 uB / 4 f.u. = 2.000); the order is the V1-antiparallel-V2 ferrimagnetic ground state.

primary.note: Total within +/-10%, exact ferrimagnetic label, V1 negative and V2 positive in the supplied fixed output orientation. Site magnitudes are not scored.

secondary.note: V1/V2 magnitudes and Co are recorded for context, not magnitude-scored. V1/V2 are required as operands of the sign checks; Co is not a required output.
